notes:
Account summary: Lighthouse builds a VS Code-first copilot extension geared to fast inline suggestions and streaming completions. Primary goal is "must feel instantaneous" for devs — CTO quote on 2026-03-01 call.

Technical constraints / ask: 
- Low-latency streaming (SSE or websocket) for per-keystroke deltas; want <50ms token latency for inline flows, p99 under 150ms.
- Per-user bursty concurrency: 150-250 active developers during workday; peak concurrency planning.
- Token budget ~1M tokens/day for pilot, expects scale to ~25M/month if successful.
- Model/version pinning mandatory: ability to pin to a tested model hash and fallback rules to cheaper/quantized variant on latency/cost spikes.
- Auth: cannot ship static API keys in extension. Prefer OAuth2 + short-lived org-scoped tokens or server-side proxy pattern (extension talks to their backend which proxies to Redwood). SCIM + SSO required for provisioning.
- Rate limits: need per-user and per-org quotas; prefer token-bucket throttling with developer-friendly backoff messages in the UI.
- Security: SOC2 compliance required, audit logs retention 12 months, EU data residency for EU customer data, KMS integration for key wrapping.
- Offline behavior: small local prefix cache for fuzzy completions acceptable but no persistent logging of source code back to Redwood without opt-in.
